description: Irregular triangle read by rows: T(1,1) = T(2,1) = 1; for n >= 3, the n-th row lists the number of Dirichet characters chi modulo n such that Q(chi) = Q(zeta_(2d)) for each divisor d of psi(n)/2, where Q(chi) is the field generated by the values of chi, and psi = A002322 is the reduced totient function.
